Chapter 6450: Gold Village

Chapter 6450: Gold Village

“Hatred comes with a cost especially when you hate someone stronger.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes.” Bronze contemplated briefly before agreeing: “Perhaps my father is already paying the price.”

“He’s not paying anything, he still has his cultivation and you have yours. Otherwise, he would be even less qualified to hate.” Li Qiye said before looking at the ground.

He then stomped down on an unfortunate ant, not leaving anything behind as he said: “Like that.”

Bronze’s expression changed continuously as he staggered backward, not knowing how to react. He was also not used to feeling inferior given his cultivation and status.

“This hatred is nothing but taking advantage of someone else’s forgiveness.” Li Qiye continued.

“It applies to you too, you are spared because of your grandparents.” The skull laughed.

A primal ancestor normally had a difficult time accepting threats. Alas, this was meant to be an advice.

“What will you do, Young Noble?” Bronze took a deep breath.

“Can’t stop someone who wants to die. All I can do is deliver him down to see the king of hell.” Li Qiye said.

He ruminated in silence before answering: “As a son, I cannot change my father’s mind.”

“The decision is yours to make, accompany him in death or preserve the bloodline.” Li Qiye said.

He had no response.

“Go, the goodwill of your grandparents is running out. He deserves to die now.” Li Qiye waved his hand.

After a brief silence, he took a deep breath and bowed: “I understand, Young Noble, and will do my best.”

Having said that, he left Gold Village entirely while the duo continued.

Everyone was busy digging since gold was power here. No one could escape this law, not even primal ancestors.

The dao was secondary to gold, albeit still useful. Weaker cultivators focused on the upper level of the soil while stronger emperors and desolate gods moved mountains and excavated the earth to find mines.

Some primal ancestors and heaven-slayers rooted themselves in the ground, letting their golden trees absorb the gold around them. Ores turned into flowing liquid converging toward a single point.

The gathering process became easier after obtaining a tree. Its laws boosted cultivation and transformed one into a gold giant.

Power increases in the dream world persisted into the real world to a certain extent. Time also flowed faster but gold improved lifespan as well. All of this culminated in an insatiable appetite to excavate.

Explosions detonated everywhere as powerful cultivators changed the landscape. Some removed mountains and brought them to another place for gold extraction.

All in all, cultivators continued to grow stronger, especially those with trees embedded into the ground. Both cultivation and lifespan improved dramatically.

Six trees stood above the rest, visible from any location. They varied in shapes but the golden laws coming from them could refine everything.

They belonged to Alch-deer Emperor, Ocean-gaze Ancestor, Luosha Devil Emperor, Iron-spear Ancestor, Earthsplitter Ancestor, and Rising Buddha.

They were the six giants of Gold Village due to their omnipresent laws, towering over the rest. Alch-deer was a special case since he was far weaker compared to the other five.

However, he had a special connection to the village and found numerous mines. Thus, he became the first with a tree and the strongest out of the six.
